newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rice prices seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rice prices seen falling.

text.p: Pakistani rice export prices are likely to fall next week as more of the crop arrives from farms, dealers said on Thursday.

"Rice export prices fell on arrival of the new crop and weak demand from abroad," an official of the state-run Rice Export Corporation of Pakistan said. Foreign buyers were waiting for Pakistani rice prices to stabilise, he added.
In September, rice exports fell to 74,748 tonnes worth $24 million from 97,779 tonnes worth $31 million in August, and compared with 72,484 tonnes worth $27 million in September 1995.
